title: Why it sucks being a Chelsea fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Chelsea fan!
It starts when you're seven. You get your first shirt, with your favourite player on the back. Next season, he's sold.
Age nine. You finally learn the manager's name. By Christmas, there's a new one.
Age twelve. The club signs so many players... the team photo needs a wider camera.
Age fourteen. The club spends over a billion on new players. Your dad says: "We'll win everything." You finish twelfth.
Age sixteen. One night in Munich. Champions League final. Penalties. Against Bayern. In their own stadium. And you win!
Age seventeen. You buy the shirt of the new signing. His contract? Eight years. By January... he's on loan.
That's the thing about being a Chelsea fan. The manager changes. The players change. Even the owner changes.
Tag a Chelsea fan who never left. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
